wormald.wormald_date: Wormald gives no date; annotations after 1568 (inferred, p. 262 n. 384)
wormald.laws: Annotations on III Atr (ff. Biiiv) and Wer (f. 71r)
wormald.other_contents: Printed Archaionomia with Lambarde's later notes.
wormald.overview: One of Lambarde's own annotated copies of Archaionomia. His later notes record his discovery of Textus Roffensis: he announces knowledge of an Old English III Æthelred and enters emendations to Wer from the Rochester text, showing that neither he nor Nowell knew Textus Roffensis when the edition appeared in 1568.
wormald.key_quote: 'Lambarde (ergo Nowell) did not know TR in 1568' (p. 262 n. 384)
wormald.doubts: Mentioned only in a footnote; shelfmark printed 'Bodl. 4^to L.5 Jur. Seld.', 'ff. Biiiv' (signature). Not in guide.
